Since the company was founded in 1991, we have become renowned for our customer care, our approach to which is summarised in our motto, "Corkills Care". Under the leadership of Group CEO, Adrian Kermode, we have continued to flourish and believe we are one of the most progressive, privately owned motor groups in the north west. We seek to employ like-minded people who want to deliver a superior level of customer service and look for innovative ways to improve our offering. As such, we have built a dedicated and friendly staff who always go the extra mile. At Corkills, we also understand the importance of being active in the local community. Our Northwich, Southport and Wigan dealerships therefore support local schools, charities and fundraising events as much as possible. It’s through these interactions that we build relationships with our customers, so that they know they can trust our integrity, and that we genuinely want to give back. This is how we have come to have so many returning customers from across the north west, and how we have come to be formally recognised for excellence in customer experience. Most notably we have received the ‘Retailer of Excellence’ award from Volkswagen several times over, in recognition of our customers’ satisfaction. Our customer service extends far beyond the initial purchase of your car. From first enquiry, through aftercare, until you are ready to purchase your next vehicle, you will be in safe hands.
